facts.label: Tirando fotos
facts.sub: Use How many + plural + did you + verbo base para perguntar números no passado: How many photos did you take? Responda com o passado: I took fifty.

facts.label: Quantos
facts.sub: Para perguntar uma quantidade de coisas que se contam, use How many + substantivo no plural: How many photos? How many animals? Nunca use how many com singular.

facts.label: Passado simples
facts.sub: Na pergunta, use did + verbo base: How many photos did you take? Na resposta, use o passado: I took fifty photos. I saw two lions. Take e see são irregulares: took e saw.
